name: Ogijima Island
description: A small art-festival island of the Setouchi Triennale, its steep lanes lined with house projects, the Ogijima Library and works by Yoshihiro Narita.
notes: Ferry from Takamatsu (~40 min); artworks change with the festival editions — check setouchi-artfest.jp.
